inference_settings.match_rule: same exact class and original-box IoU >= 0.50

caveats: All nine images are previously development-exposed; no independent validation claim.
Deletion is a one-step black-fill target-box perturbation, not a ranked pixel-deletion curve.
Insertion is a one-step target-only sufficiency probe, not a progressive insertion curve or AUC.
Bounding-box perturbations can include background/context; target-box area fraction is recorded.
The hosted Workflow does not expose process memory or physical energy in Joules.
Workflow wall-clock includes network/provider overhead and is not isolated model latency.
The first 30-pass V28 attempt had no persisted outputs and is excluded from analysis; an exact 30-pass repeat was archived.
